items: The regional office has ____ meeting rooms, so teams often reserve them several days in advance.
'Meeting rooms' is countable plural, so 'few' is correct.
There is ____ interest in extending the warranty beyond five years, according to the survey.
We received ____ useful suggestions during yesterday's staff workshop.
'Suggestions' is countable plural, and 'a few' expresses a small positive number.
The finance team still has ____ time to review the figures before the report is released.
'Time' is uncountable, and 'a little' expresses a small positive amount.
Very ____ vendors can meet the new delivery requirement without changing their schedules.
'Vendors' is countable plural, so 'few' is correct after 'Very'.
The prototype showed ____ improvement after the first software update.
'Improvement' is uncountable here, so 'little' is correct.
The receptionist kept ____ brochures at the front desk for walk-in visitors.
'Brochures' is countable plural, and 'a few' expresses a small positive number.
With ____ additional training, the new employees should be able to use the system independently.
'Training' is uncountable, and 'a little' expresses a small positive amount.
Only ____ customers requested paper invoices after the online billing option was introduced.
'Customers' is countable plural, so 'few' is correct after 'Only'.
The revised contract leaves ____ uncertainty about who is responsible for maintenance costs.
The supervisor approved ____ changes to the seating plan before the event began.
'Changes' is countable plural, and 'a few' expresses a small positive number.
Please add ____ water to the cleaning solution before using it on the glass panels.
'Water' is uncountable, and 'a little' expresses a small positive amount.
The training session attracted ____ participants from outside the sales department.
'Participants' is countable plural, so 'few' is correct.
Because the machine produces ____ noise, it can be installed near the customer service area.

'Questions' is countable plural, and 'a few' expresses a small positive number.

'Information' is uncountable, and 'a little' expresses a small positive amount.
There are ____ direct flights during the winter, so business travelers usually connect through Osaka.
'Direct flights' is countable plural, so 'few' is correct.
The marketing campaign generated ____ publicity outside the company's existing customer base.
The warehouse has ____ spare carts available for unusually large deliveries.
'Spare carts' is countable plural, and 'a few' expresses a small positive number.
Adding ____ insulation around the pipe should reduce heat loss considerably.
'Insulation' is uncountable, and 'a little' expresses a small positive amount.
____ employees were willing to work the holiday shift at short notice.
'Employees' is countable plural, so 'few' is correct.
The report provides ____ evidence that the delay affected customer satisfaction.
The software update introduced ____ minor changes to the login screen.
'Changes' is countable plural, and 'a few' expresses a small positive number.
There is ____ storage space left on the shared server, so old files should be archived.
'Storage space' is uncountable, so 'little' is correct.
Only ____ applicants completed both parts of the technical assessment.
'Applicants' is countable plural, so 'few' is correct after 'Only'.
